baseline.title: Diffeomorphic approximation of planar W¹,¹ homeomorphisms
baseline.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝ², every homeomorphism f∈W¹,¹(Ω,ℝ²) admits smooth diffeomorphisms and locally finitely piecewise affine homeomorphisms arbitrarily close both uniformly and in W¹,¹. If f extends continuously to ∂Ω, approximants can have the same boundary values.

current.title: Diffeomorphic approximation of planar W¹,¹ homeomorphisms
current.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝ², every homeomorphism f∈W¹,¹(Ω,ℝ²) admits smooth diffeomorphisms and locally finitely piecewise affine homeomorphisms arbitrarily close both uniformly and in W¹,¹. If f extends continuously to ∂Ω, approximants can have the same boundary values. On a polygonal domain, when f is piecewise affine on the boundary, the affine approximant can use a finite triangulation.
